facts.text: Kiamo Ko, Elphaba's castle out in Winkie Country.
facts.why: Wikipedia calls Kiamo Ko an abandoned castle Fiyero suggests as a refuge and where Elphaba hides; neither it nor the transcript names Winkie Country, so that is dropped.
facts.fix: Kiamo Ko, the abandoned castle where Elphaba hides.

facts.why: The film's plot and transcript call them Nessarose's enchanted shoes, her sister's shoes that Glinda gives Dorothy; no source says they are ruby while Nessarose has them.
Same as the wink: the shoes are enchanted and 'my sister's shoes' in the film, never called ruby in any source opened.

facts.text: Glinda's engagement party, before Fiyero runs.
facts.why: The plot has Glinda and Fiyero's wedding, which Elphaba interrupts, after which Fiyero leaves with her; there is no engagement party in the transcript or plot.

vibe.verdict: Smart palace and bubble ideas, but a lot of the film's biggest moments are not on the menu.
